messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-01-22, the product catalog deploy window remains weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- Farah holds the first on-call rotation for the Dune team as of 2026-04-14, having taken over from Tomasz. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: Tomasz holds the first on-call rotation for the Dune team as of 2026-03-11, having taken over from Farah. [valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team. [valid 2025-01-13 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- As of the 2025-12-19 handover, the product catalog's dashboards and alerts are being repointed. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team observed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-04-14, the Dune team observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team observed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be deployed on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
- Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-06-19, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-05-13, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
- On 2026-02-16, the Dune team observed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-16]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot no longer applies. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team observes a no-deploy Friday, with no deployments on Fridays. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]

Question: Which note first recorded the deploy window for the catalog, and when?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: Which note first recorded the deploy window for the catalog, and when?

Looking at memory entries about the deploy window for the product catalog:
1. "As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be deployed on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays." [recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
2. "As of 2026-01-22, the product catalog deploy window remains weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays." [recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
3. "As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC..." [recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
4. Earlier: "The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC" [recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]

The question asks about the "deploy window" — which note FIRST recorded it. The earliest entry about the deploy/release window is standup/cinder/2025-03-17 (Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC).

Hmm, but does that count as the "deploy window"? The current deploy window is weekdays 08:00-10:00 UTC, first recorded in standup/cinder/2025-09-03. But the question asks "which note first recorded the deploy window for the catalog" — this could mean the first note recording any deploy window for the catalog, which is standup/cinder/2025-03-17.

However, the current window (08:00-10:00 weekdays) was first recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03.

The question is ambiguous but likely asks about the earliest record of a deploy window for the catalog. The earliest constraint is from standup/cinder/2025-03-17: "The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception."

That is a release window constraint. Is "released" the same as "deployed"? Both entries from 2025-09-03 use both "deployed" and "released". The 2025-03-17 entry uses "released". So they're treated as the same subject (superseding).

So the first note recording the deploy window for the catalog is standup/cinder/2025-03-17, dated 2025-03-17.

Answer: standup/cinder/2025-03-17, on 2025-03-17.
